title: Unnamed settlement near Beni Mouhli, Algeria
description: Remains of an ancient settlement of Roman date, recorded by Gsell (AAA, whence BAtlas). The location should lie within 2km of the BAtlas coordinates: a point north of the modern CW15 roadway in the municipal territory of modern At Muḥli/Beni Mouhli in Algeria's Setif province.

properties.description: Coordinates extracted using QGIS from a raster image of Barrington Atlas Map 31 that was georegistered to OpenStreetMap using prominent, stable landscape features. Dates after BAltDir.
